messages:
carmen_cs: Heads-up team: PioneerRx QBR on Mon — they asked for a focused "cost + runway" slide and an ops mitigation checklist. Need a crisp 2-slide appendix: (A) 60/90d token forecast and top-10 prompt heatmap, (B) three short remediation paths with impact estimates. Can @ryan_data pull prompt-level usage (45d) and a 90d burn projection by EOD Fri? @priya_fin build three cost scenarios and a recommended renewal ask (reserve vs credits). cc @tom_sales for ask language.

ryan_data: On it. I'll run the grouped query for last 45d and produce gen vs embed split + top prompt contributors. Quick note: we saw a recent embed indexing job spike last week — will flag if it's driving the burn.

priya_fin: I'll model baseline (current growth), conservative (-10% opt), and high-case (feature-led +30% burst). I'll include estimated $ delta and a suggested 15% reserve cushion to propose to Sales.

infra-bot: USAGE ALERT: PioneerRx reached 70% of monthly threshold (threshold=900,000,000 tokens) as of 2026-03-22T09:18:00Z. Auto-suggested: enable batching on top gen prompts.

carmen_cs: Good catch, infra-bot. Tom, Sales wants a non-threatening ask — prefer "3mo reserve with flexible bump" phrasing. Can you draft a one-liner we can paste on the ask slide?

ryan_data: Ran query. Top contributors: "rx_daily_digest_gen" 3.1M tokens (gen), "patient_index_embeds" 1.9M tokens (embeds), "longform_conversation" 2.4M tokens (gen), plus an automated nightly index job that added ~800k tokens last week. Uploaded CSV -> https://internal.redwood/data/pioneer-prompts-1748001111.csv

ryan_data: 30d averages: gen 1.05M/day, embed 0.45M/day. Growth trend ~9%/mo. Raw 90d projection (no mitigation) ~125M tokens. Small JSON snippet:```json
{"30d_gen":1050000,"30d_emb":450000,"proj_90d":125000000}```

priya_fin: Nice. Quick cost sketch (public pricing): baseline 90d ~$11.3k. Conservative w/ 15% opt -> ~$9.6k. High-case bursts -> ~$15.0k. If Sales secures a 3mo reserved commit (20% discount) and we apply recommended batching, effective 90d cost to customer ~ $7.7k and reduces renewal friction.

tom_sales: Draft ask line: "We recommend a 3‑month reserved commitment (20% discount) with an optional 15% buffer. This preserves performance while lowering unit cost—happy to pilot batching for 8 weeks and revert if no improvement." Thoughts?

carmen_cs: That's good — succinct. Add optional credit: 10% one-time credit on first invoice if they sign within QBR window. Keep it as a negotiable sweetener.

ryan_data: For slide visuals: I exported a stacked burn chart (gen vs embed) + top-10 prompt heatmap. Chart link: https://internal.redwood/graphs/pioneer-burn-1748001111. CSV has a column "likely_optimize" tagging cacheable/index-batchable jobs.

infra-bot: SUGGESTED RUNBOOK: 
1) If daily_tokens > baseline_daily_avg * 1.25 for 2 days => alert ops.
2) Auto-enable request-level batching for prompts tagged "cacheable".
3) Route heavy gen to reserved pool during index jobs.
Example commands:
```bash
# enable batching for customer
redwood config set --customer pioneer --feature batching --value enabled
# route index job to reserved pool
redwood infra route --customer pioneer --job index --pool reserved-temp
# set soft throttle
redwood rate-limit set --customer pioneer --limit 220r/s
```

carmen_cs: Perfect. Priya, can you add a one-paragraph renewal rationale for the deck notes (why reserve reduces churn risk + simplifies billing)? Also include the dollar math in speaker notes.

priya_fin: Will do. I'll paste the dollar table into notes and a short paragraph: "Reserved commits reduce price volatility, provide predictable spend, and can be structured with a buffer to absorb short-term bursts. Combined with batching, customers often see 20-30% unit cost reductions."

tom_sales: I'll prep a two-sentence negotiation script: short opener + optional credit sweetener. Ready to drop into slide.

carmen_cs: Timeline: Ryan deliver CSV + charts by Fri 2pm PT, Priya deliver cost tables + paragraph by Fri 3pm PT, Tom deliver ask scripts by Fri 3:30pm PT. I'll assemble slides and run a dry-run Sat 10am PT. Any blockers?

ryan_data: No blockers. CSV and chart ETA 1:30pm PT.

priya_fin: On track. I'll put sensitivity rows (±10/±25%) into notes.

infra-bot: REMINDER: If auto-batching is toggled on for customer, rerun perf tests in staging to ensure compatibility with their client integration.

carmen_cs: Noted — tagging eng-oncall for the dry-run. Thanks everyone :sparkles:

tom_sales: I'll join the dry-run and bring renewal language.

carmen_cs: Closing thread; will post deck link when assembled.
